title: 短对话细节题
goal: 定位时间、地点、物品和原因，识别细节的同义改写。

points.label: 听出与问题对应的明确细节

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 短对话细节的教学内容与课程小测规格

body.p: 细节题问对话中明确说出的时间、地点、物品或原因。选项常换用同义的说法，人物和条件要与原话一致。

body.box:
Why is the market closed? → The roof is being repaired.
It is closed for roof repairs.

body.p: roof repairs 是 the roof is being repaired 的另一种说法，关门的原因没有变。

steps.d: 先看疑问词问的是哪类信息。Where 问地点，why 问原因。
找到说题干中人物和事件的那句话。Leo left the key in the kitchen 说明 Leo 把钥匙留在了哪里。
注意时间、物主和否定。The red bag isn't mine 说明红色的包不是说话者的。
看选项的意思是否与原话相同。The shop is shut 与 The shop is closed 意思相同。

cards.title: 细节定位
rows: The talk begins at half past four.
The parcel is behind the counter.
说话者带上了蓝色围巾。
The path is closed because a tree fell.

cards.title: 细节的同义改写
rows: The meeting will begin at noon.
The meeting will start at twelve.
The parcel hasn't arrived; it's still at the depot.
The parcel is still at the depot.
A branch fell across the path.
A fallen branch blocked the path.
She packed a shirt and trousers.

body.box:
A: Has the package reached the studio?
B: Not yet. The driver called; the van is still on the road.
A: I'll wait before starting work.

Where is the package?
1. At the studio.
2. On the way.
3. In the studio's workroom.
4. Parked outside the studio.

body.p: Not yet 与 the van is still on the road 说明包裹还在路上。第二项用 on the way 改写这一状态。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: Nora packed the scarf → Leo packed the scarf
核对动作是谁做的：装围巾的是 Nora。
The parcel hasn't arrived → It has arrived
hasn't 是否定：包裹还没到。
The door opens at six; the show starts at seven → show at six
六点是开门，七点才是演出。
A fallen branch blocked the path → The path caused the branch to fall
原因是树枝倒下，结果是道路被堵。

lines.text: I left my sketchbook on the bench beside the pond. Did you see it when you collected the brushes from the table?
Yes, I brought it inside. It's on the shelf beside the brushes now.

options: On the bench beside the pond
On the table near the pond
On the shelf beside the brushes
On the table with the brushes
items.why: It's on the shelf beside the brushes now 给出现在的位置，第三项符合。

lines.text: Will the garden gate be open this morning? I need to deliver the plants, and the other entrance is too narrow for the cart.
Yes. The gate isn't locked today, so the cart can go through.

items.stem: What is true of the garden gate today?
options: It is too narrow for the cart.
It is locked until the plants arrive.
It is narrower than the other entrance.
items.why: isn't locked today 说明今天未上锁，第一项用 unlocked 改写。

lines.text: I thought the drawing class started at five. Why are you leaving at four? The walk to the studio only takes ten minutes.
I have to buy paper first. The class does start at five.

items.stem: Why is the second speaker leaving at four?
items.why: I have to buy paper first 给出提前出发的原因，第四项符合。

lines.text: What did Mei put in the box for the trip? I put the cups in my bag, but there's still room for something else.
She put apples and pears in the box. The cups can stay in your bag.

items.stem: What did Mei put in the box?
items.why: apples and pears 都是水果，第二项概括盒中的物品。

lines.text: The exhibition doors open at nine, but when does the guided tour start? I need to arrange a bus for the group.
The tour starts at ten. Ask everyone to arrive before then.

items.stem: When does the guided tour start?
items.why: The tour starts at ten 明确说明导览时间，第一项符合。

lines.text: Did Zara take her jacket to the sports hall? She left her water bottle beside the door when she went out this morning.
She took the jacket, but her bottle is still beside the door.

items.stem: What did Zara take with her?
items.why: She took the jacket 指 Zara 带走外套，第二项符合；水瓶仍在门边。

lines.text: Can we use the room beside the kitchen for the meeting? The room upstairs is being painted, and the tables are still outside.
Yes. The downstairs room isn't occupied this afternoon.

items.stem: What does the second speaker say about the downstairs room?
options: It is upstairs from the kitchen.
items.why: isn't occupied this afternoon 表示下午空着，vacant 是同义改写。

lines.text: Why did the delivery arrive late? The driver usually reaches the bakery before the first customers come in at eight.
A fallen tree blocked the road, so the driver had to take another route.

options: The other route was blocked by a tree.
A tree obstructed the usual road.
items.why: A fallen tree blocked the road 是延误的原因，obstructed 改写 blocked。

lines.text: Have you seen the tickets for the play? I checked the drawer under the phone, but they're not there with the programme.
I put the tickets in the blue envelope on the desk.

options: In an envelope on the desk
In the drawer under the phone
Beside the programme in the drawer
In a blue envelope in the drawer
items.why: in the blue envelope on the desk 指明票的位置，第一项符合。

lines.text: What did you buy for the class picnic? I bought bread and cheese, but I didn't have enough time to visit the fruit stall.
I bought oranges and bananas there. They're in the bag by the door.

items.stem: What did the second speaker buy?
options: Bread and cheese for the class
A bag for the fruit stall
items.why: oranges and bananas 属于水果，第二项概括第二位说话者购买的物品。
